annotations.title: UAE Golden Visa and Green Visa checker

description: Checks which UAE long-term visa routes a person meets: Golden Visa (property or investment of AED 2 million; skilled professional with a degree, MOHRE level 1-2 and AED 30,000 a month), Green Visa (skilled employee AED 15,000 a month; freelancer AED 360,000 a year) and the remote work visa (US$3,500 a month). Source: https://borbur.net/tools/uae-golden-visa-checker/

mohre_level.description: MOHRE skill level of the UAE job: 12 = level 1 or 2, 3 = level 3

monthly_salary.description: Monthly salary in the chosen currency

work.description: uae = employed by a UAE company; remote = works for an employer/clients abroad; free = freelancer; none
